Hi @virtuman there's nothing to do that today inside instantsearch.js.

Doing faceting with Algolia you cannot enrich facet values by default.

If what you care about is new items, then you could add a "new\_arrival:true" field to your hits inside Algolia then use this field in the custom ranking. Doing so will give a ranking boost to new arrivals. Combine this with sorting facet values by "count" then you should get a OK experience I guess.

Let us know
